Consultant will complete construction design documents for a new fishing Pier at Spanaway Lake Park. The consultant completing the work will have experience and expertise on similar projects with the following items and deliverables but not limited to; Complete pier design Construction drawings Specification preparation Cost Estimating Bid assistance Permitting o Assist with permit o Regulatory submittals o Permit Questions Construction administration services Construction administration specific to a new pier.
